method: Actual local production Chromium screenshots at DPR 1 and continuous native Playwright browser recordings. MP4/GIF conversions omit only the first 0.12s of recorder-surface initialization and otherwise change encoding only, without seeking the app timeline, changing playback speed, replacing CSS or constructing frames. A single native scroll early in each recording keeps the stage and caption visible; the initial top view is retained separately. Reduced-motion and no-JavaScript full pages are explicitly separate static evidence. Software rendering is not a physical-device performance benchmark.
